content: The original SQuAD, Text-SQuAD, is chosen as the source domain data, where only question answering pairs appearing in Spoken-SQuAD are utilized. In our task setting, during training we train the proposed QA model on both Text-SQuAD and Spoken-SQuAD training sets. While in the testing stage, we evaluate the performance on Spoken-SQuAD testing set.
